implementation.collection: One bounded retained archive read per batch; explicit bounded windows, source identities and independent eligibility/acceptance facets. No network or workflow execution.
implementation.measure: Protected eligible activations, percent; independent accepted counts and denial/no-inference/notification facets retained separately from contribution.
boundaryDecisions: Normative equality-at-cap is exceeded; cap is 1 AIC, not the per-run maximum.
Manual and command dispatch bypasses do not count as failures.
No accepted denial from generic failed jobs, missing inference logs or the intentionally nonexistent tool.
Unknown eligible population is null; observedEligibleCount is a separate bounded subtotal.
Positive partial native evidence survives missing full acceptance, cohort or contribution facts.
No historical predicate application before prospective contract activation at the frozen cutoff.

validation.syntax: node --check on the owned module, acquisition script and test; passed
validation.standardEvaluatorResult: passed; timeline, definitions, evidence archive and interactive pulse retained
validation.bootstrapPermissionNote: Seed scripts were not executable. Their execute bit was enabled only during standard evaluator execution and restored in finally; no helper content changes were made.
validation.toolingLimitation: No installed ESLint or TypeScript binaries were available; no installation was authorized. No workflow source was changed or executed.

evidence.discoveryUse: Lineage discovery only; not native activations, acceptance, contribution, complete inference coverage or billing facts.
evidence.sourceBodies: Lossless base64 Git blobs with original Git ID, byte count and SHA-256; includes complete available workflow, reporting import, specification, compiler, notification templates and tests.
evidence.syntheticFixtures: Tests only; explicitly synthetic and dubious; excluded from actual native archive and evaluation.
evidence.additionReadiness: Verified actual path addition against parent and not a shallow boundary; addition source and compiled bodies missing.

retainedEvaluation.status: initial partial native period; missing authenticated evidence
retainedEvaluation.decision: not rated; no source-derived keep bar
